title: Web Locks Leader Election & Crash Failover
description: Trace how Tab A holds an exclusive Web Lock, broadcasts updates to Tab B, and how Tab B promotes on Tab A close.

steps.label: 1. Tab A Acquires Leader Lock
steps.description: Tab A wins navigator.locks.request('tab-leader'), opens the WebSocket, and posts updates to BroadcastChannel.

steps.label: 2. Tab A Closes or Crashes
steps.description: User closes Tab A; the browser engine automatically releases the Web Lock without heartbeat timeouts.
steps.codeHighlight: // Browser Lock Manager releases 'tab-leader' on context termination

steps.label: 3. Tab B Promotes to Leader
steps.description: Tab B's queued lock callback resolves immediately, opening a single replacement WebSocket.
